chunks: Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah and ‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far, all together, narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother ‘Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, who said:
Mūsā ibn Ja‘far (عليه السلام) was taken at the age of fifty-four years, in the year one hundred and eighty-three, and he lived for thirty-five years after Ja‘far (عليه السلام).

key_terms.ثَلَاثٍ وَثَمَانِينَ وَمِائَةٍ: the year one hundred and eighty-three
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; was taken in death

ai.seo_question: When did Imam Mūsā ibn Ja‘far (عليه السلام) die, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This report gives a brief biographical notice about Imam Mūsā ibn Ja‘far (عليه السلام), stating his age at the time of his passing, the year of his death, and the number of years he lived after Imam Ja‘far (عليه السلام). Its significance lies in preserving key chronological details within the biographical history of the Imams (عليهم السلام).
